706.4 Heel- or side-inlet quarter bends.
Heel-inlet quarter bends shall be an acceptable means of connection, except where
                  the quarter bend serves as water closet. A low-heel inlet shall not be used as a wet-vented
                  connection. Side-inlet quarter bends shall be an acceptable means of connection for
                  drainage, wet venting and stack venting arrangements.
